data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open the booking form, optionally toggle Book with miles, type and pick the origin and destination, open the Depart picker and choose dates, click Find flights, then select a fare), but it adds optional traveler, cabin and results-page steps that are vague and omits a single travelers parameter, though the steps are concrete enough to automate.
